Laser Dentistry — Internal Draft

This structure separates dental laser technology from aesthetic skin-laser content. No dental device, procedure, provider training, indication, limitation, aftercare, or offer is confirmed.

Blocked practice input

Technology is not a service claim

The practice decision register does not confirm dental laser device(s) or procedures. Do not infer laser gingivectomy, gum contouring, periodontal use, sleep protocol, or any other dental application from aesthetic DEKA content or from the prior audit.

No public routeNo device claimNo procedure claim

Page structure

What must be confirmed

Service versus technology

Identify the actual dental service first, then explain where a confirmed device may be used. Keep dental laser and aesthetic skin laser language separate.

Confirmed applications

None are confirmed in the current practice decisions. Do not list gingivectomy, gum contouring, periodontal uses, or other procedures as offered.

Provider and qualifications

Require the performing provider, training, and publishable qualifications before creating a public claim.

Patient benefit, candidacy, expectations, limitations

Obtain clinician-reviewed language for each confirmed application. Avoid universal comfort, safety, outcome, and recovery claims.

Aftercare and related care

Publish only procedure-specific instructions with a named clinical owner and review date.

FAQ structure

Questions to complete

Which device is used?

Pending exact practice input. Do not borrow device details from aesthetic content.

What procedures use it?

Pending confirmed procedure list and indications.

Is a laser always used?

No such generalization is allowed. The treatment and technology relationship must be explained per confirmed procedure.

Laser consultation CTA blocked

Enable only after device, procedure, provider, limitations, aftercare, and destination are approved.
